description: Hand-written in the documented response format (no live capture possible in the build environment); field names are exactly the ones the adapters read. Bodies are raw response text, expectations are the parsed Ticker (-1 = Ticker.NO_DATA, change24hPercent null = must not be set). Shared by ExchangeContractTest.kt (Android) and ExchangeContractTests.swift (iOS).

cases.name: spot: 24 hourly candles (newest first) -> rolling 24 h ticker
spot: 24 hourly candles but one hour missing (timestamps not contiguous) -> incomplete window, no change
spot: fewer than 24 candles -> no change
spot, request 1: last trade (live capture 20 Oct 2026) -> real last price and its time
spot, request 1: no trades -> error, candle price stays
spot: 25 candles, newest = running hour (response time inside it) -> 24 full hours + the running one
spot: 25 candles, newest already closed (running hour not delivered yet) -> exactly the 24 full hours, oldest ignored
spot: newest candle more than an hour old (window does not end now) -> no change
spot: 25 candles without response time -> newest counts as running hour
spot: live response recorded 2026-10-16 (running candle) -> exchangeTime = response time of the envelope
bulk futures: row with renamed 24hClose is reported as unreadable (bulkRow), the rest stays
bulk futures: row with null 24hClose (inactive) is skipped, not reported as unreadable
